ledger: Woman | Arms folded, resting on car hood | Arms folded, resting on car hood | Torso continuously clips through the solid hood of the car
Car | Stationary, solid hood | Stationary, solid hood | Intersected by woman's body

findings.description: The woman's torso appears to emerge directly from and clip through the solid metal hood of the car. There is no opening; her body impossibly intersects the solid geometry of the vehicle.
